text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant! Wheeze!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
It appears that the rumors surrounding
Narita
Brian are true. She's running very
differently from
how she used to.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Yes, she is... I hope she'll be able to fully
recover
soon.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Raaah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She didn't do too bad. Looks like it's
coming back
to her, bit by bit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, it feels like there's something
missing. But
what could it be?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Teach! I wanna do even more uphill
sprints!

More? We've already finished everything
I had
planned for today's training, and
she's got to be
tired...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'm startin' to see what I need to do.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And in order to see that through, I've
gotta aim
high.

That's... abstract, but I can tell she's
serious. If
this is what it takes to make
the one-on-one with
Brian a reality, so
be it.

To fans, the pair's rivalry might look
different
now... but I know they haven't
changed a bit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

Hishi Amazon runs the incline with all
her might.
Our days of extra training
have begun.

The autumn Tenno Sho is finally here.
Narita
Brian's health is still the talk of
the town, but the
audience's
expectations for her remain high.
However...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian the Beast has finished
today's race
without baring her fangs
once!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
What in the world was that?! She never
used to
run like that!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

As Narita Brian stands there, a prodigy
stripped
of her former strength, hushed
conversations
begin to ripple through
the stands.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Are her injuries not fully healed or
something? I
wonder if she'll ever be
able to make a full
recovery like this...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Will we ever be able to see Narita Brian
in her
prime again?
A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Today, we have an impressive racer with
us. She's
taking the world by storm with
her amazing
running skills and has won a
slew of G1 races...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
And that racer is none other than Hishi
Amazon!
Thank you for agreeing to be
interviewed right
before the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Thanks, the pleasure is mine!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
To start, I recall you naming Narita Brian
your
rival at the Arima Kinen last year...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
But who would you say is your rival for
the Japan
Cup?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
My rival is the same as always—Narita
Brian! I'm
gonna work hard to overcome
her!

It's no secret that Narita Brian has been
in poor
health, so the entire room leans
in, curious to
hear the rest of Hishi
Amazon's answer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
I know she's been off her game, and I
know her
fans are feeling let
down—worried.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She isn't back to runnin' like the beast
you knew.
That speaks for itself, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She's not done just yet. I'm sure you
know this as
well as I do.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian isn't strong just because
she's
"talented."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
She's strong because she never stops
running.

Hishi Amazon's frank declaration stuns
the press
conference hall into still
silence.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to worry about her.
She's gonna
be okay.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: She's the Narita Brian, y'know. She'll be able to make her way back to the top, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Who my rival is will never change.

Her stance on the matter spreads
through the
media like wildfire...

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did you see that interview with
Hishi
Amazon? The one where she said
Narita Brian is
still her rival.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I did. I've gotta admit, her speech
really hit
me in the heart...

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
And she's right, y'know? The look on
Narita
Brian's face when she runs is just
as fierce as it
always was.

Slowly, the public's opinion of Narita
Brian begins
to shift.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's do this, Teach!

I watch as Hishi Amazon, strong and
gallant as
ever, sprints up the incline.

There's not much longer now until the
Japan Cup.
